findings.evidence: The generic ingredients all exist: `baseChangeProd` is stated for an arbitrary commutative algebra (TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/QuadraticForm/BaseChange.lean:264), `Nondegenerate.baseChange` at BaseChange.lean:658, `equivalent_of_equivalent_prod` at TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/QuadraticForm/Witt/Cancellation.lean:196. The house pattern of generic lemma + `simpa only [atFinitePlace_def]`/`[atRealPlace_def]` wrapper is at TauCeti/NumberTheory/QuadraticForm/Global/Localization.lean:196 and :206 (and :165, :175).
findings.fix: Prove it once over an arbitrary extension, e.g. `baseChange_equivalent_of_prod_equivalent_prod_of_equivalent (L) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Invertible (2 : L)] (hP' : P'.Nondegenerate) (h : (P'.prod V).Equivalent (P.prod W)) (hPP' : (P.baseChange L).Equivalent (P'.baseChange L)) : (V.baseChange L).Equivalent (W.baseChange L)` using `baseChangeProd`, `Nondegenerate.baseChange` and `equivalent_of_equivalent_prod`, and make the two place statements thin wrappers (`simpa only [atFinitePlace_def]` / `[atRealPlace_def]`), as `QuadraticMap.Equivalent.atFinitePlace`/`atRealPlace` already do.
findings.issue: `atFinitePlace_equivalent_of_prod_equivalent_prod_of_equivalent` (lines 107-116) and `atRealPlace_equivalent_of_prod_equivalent_prod_of_equivalent` (lines 119-129) repeat the same proof verbatim modulo the localization functor (transport along the product isometry, then `equivalent_of_equivalent_prod`); the reusable fact — Witt cancellation survives any scalar extension — is never stated. The same `⟨atFinitePlaceProd P' V v⟩` / `⟨atFinitePlaceProd P W v⟩` wrappings are then re-inlined a third time at lines 102-103 and 152-153.

summary: Proofs are short, automation-friendly, and free of undocumented defeq manipulation. One factoring issue: the place-independent "cancel after scalar extension" argument is written out separately for the finite and the real place instead of being proved once over an arbitrary base change, against the idiom already used in Global/Localization.lean.
